facts.fact: Kenya began biometric enrolment of dependants aged 7 to 17 under the SHA system, each to be issued a Maisha Namba, which Health CS Duale said would link each child to a health record and make medical history, immunisation logs and treatment records accessible at any SHA facility; the report gives no start date, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: Social Health Authority / Ministry of Health
systems.tiers: 'any SHA facility', as the minister puts it

note: Classed emr only on the minister's description of a per-child health record (medical history, immunisation logs, treatment records) retrievable at any SHA facility, which is stated as the aim of the enrolment and not as a count of facilities or records. Maisha Namba is the national identifier, entered as enabling for want of a closer class.
